air.source: NIST, Better Accuracy Out of Thin (or Thick) Air
air.limits: Typical ambient reference, not full Ciddor dispersion or pressure/temperature/humidity dependence.

gel.source: Thorlabs G608N3 Index Matching Gel, manufacturer specifications
gel.limits: Manufacturer Cauchy fit; continuation below first published point 402 nm is unvalidated. Not a measurement of an unspecified MINE gel.

glue.limits: No refractive-index dispersion supplied; constant over optical range is an explicit approximation.

absorption: Disabled at user request (infinite absorption length); no WLS, scintillation or bulk scattering in filling.
particle_transport: Gel PDMS composition proxy C2H6OSi, density 1.06 g/cm3; glue generic DGEBA epoxy proxy C21H24O4, density 1.17 g/cm3. Commercial compositions are not claimed. Air N/O/Ar mass fractions at 20 C and 1 atm.
runtime: Gel Cauchy sampled at 4001 energy points spanning 1-6 eV, native Geant4 GROUPVEL derived from RINDEX; constant air/glue indices. Smooth uncoated dielectric interfaces.
geometry: Square 2x2 mm open on z_MC=0, fiber centered at z_MC=1 mm; merged filling network, clipped to panel boundary, same external wrapping across flush openings.
